title: Suit Up for Battle
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Suit Up for Battle | Spiritual Warfare, Truth, Prayer, and Salvation - Ephesians v6:10-18

We are in a real spiritual battle, and our strength is never enough on its own. In Ephesians v6:10-18, God calls us to be strong in His might, to recognize that our true enemy is not flesh and blood, and to stand firm against the devil’s schemes. Victory begins when we stop trusting ourselves and learn to rely on the Lord.

God’s armor covers every part of life with what we desperately need: truth to hold us steady, righteousness to guard the heart, the gospel of peace to ground our steps, faith to quench the enemy’s fiery darts, and salvation to protect the mind. The Word of God is our sword, and prayer is not a last resort but a constant lifeline.

We are also reminded that forgiveness in Jesus Christ is our greatest need. Salvation is not found in human effort, but in believing the gospel, confessing our sin, yielding our will, and trusting the Savior who gave Himself for us. In every struggle, we are called to stand, persevere, and keep believing.
